name: dsh-mobile
description: 在 iPhone 上远程使用电脑的 DeepSeek Harness：WSS 经公网中转，4G/5G 可用，电脑不需要公网 IP。Native iOS client for remote DSH sessions.
author: jayantTang

scripts.test: npm --prefix plugins/mobile-link test && npm --prefix plugins/send-image test && npm --prefix plugins/doubao-image test && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/dev/dsh-restart.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-contracts.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-traps.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-layers.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-plugin-hotplug.test.mjs scripts/dev/plugin-hmr.test.mjs scripts/dev/profile-parity.test.mjs scripts/dev/profile-parity-apply.test.mjs scripts/dev/relay-devices.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-lanes.test.mjs scripts/dev/feedback.test.mjs scripts/dev/collect-diagnostics.test.mjs scripts/dev/check-diagnostics.test.mjs scripts/dev/ios-logs.test.mjs scripts/release/ota-version.test.mjs test/tools/relaypair.test.mjs skills/send-image/send-image.test.mjs
scripts.check:ios-modules: cd ios/DSHMobile/Modules && swift test && xcodebuild test -scheme DSHMobileModules-Package -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=DSH-Test"
